claims.statement: Dashboard guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES. Issue/PR dashboards display open authored items and support created/assigned/mentioned filters plus PR review requests across subscribed and unsubscribed repositories; this is identity/query-scoped accessible display, not a complete estate inventory.

Search/filter choices narrow results. Missing inaccessible, closed or unselected items cannot be inferred absent or compliant; complete assessment requires independently declared target denominator and permission accounting.

Saved views are created on Issues dashboard to monitor across repositories, with maximum 25. Query uses advanced filters; is:pr includes PRs. Saved view is not a Projects view or automatic enforcement binding.

Creation supplies title/description/icon/query then Save view; edit/duplicate/delete target exact chosen view. Duplication copies a view, not underlying issue/PR objects; deletion removes view, not evidence of item deletion.

Guide does not specify saved-view permissions/sharing, query pagination/freshness or durable recovery after deletion. These remain unknown until adapter/behavioral review rather than inferred private/current/restorable.

Dashboard stale-item cleanup and closure are described possible actions, not universal instructions or authority to close this project issues. Display or saved query cannot certify accepted work or native rollout.
